versions.changelog:
- Updated setup instructions to clarify that the API key and billing are now managed at pipispy.com, while the product UI and dashboard are at pipiads.com.
- No changes to functionality or commands.

- Added concise setup instructions for obtaining and setting the PIPIADS_API_KEY.
- No changes to core functionality or tools.

Initial release: Combines TikTok and Facebook adspy functions with Meta Ad Library research in a single skill.

- Enables cross-platform comparison and research on ads, products, advertisers, and stores.
- Offers both adspy (discovery) and Meta Ad Library (compliance/monitoring) workflows.
- Lists key API tools and describes recommended usage patterns.
- Outlines cost per API call and credit usage from your PipiAds account.
